title: The Stack: 3 TB of permissively licensed source code

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the dataset volume and file counts across 30 programming languages to demonstrate the overrepresentation of widely adopted languages (like C and JavaScript) compared to niche languages (like Julia and Scala).

Extracting docstrings and comments from a sample of Python files and using a fasttext language detection model to compute the distribution of natural languages, revealing a 96% overrepresentation of English.
